covers: The US session on Monday 16 November 2026 and the SA overnight to 06:00 on Tuesday 17 November
headline: Wall Street closed lower on Monday: Nasdaq -2.5%, S&P 500 -1.9%; Nvidia reports today
summary: The JSE All Share closed 0.8% lower at 111,526 on Monday and the rand was at R16.96/$ early on Tuesday, weaker than Friday's R16.76/$, ahead of SA CPI on Wednesday and the SARB decision on Thursday (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 16-17 Nov 2026). In New York the S&P 500 closed 1.9% lower at 7,416.59 and the Nasdaq Composite 2.5% lower at 24,509.76, with the US 10-year yield at 5.12% (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), close 16 Nov 2026). Brent fell 4.3% to $91.71 while gold slipped 0.2% to $3,878.60 and platinum 1.0% to $1,474.20; Nvidia's results later today are the main event for tech shares (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), close 16 Nov 2026).

items.title: S&P 500 closes 1.9% lower at 7,416.59; Nasdaq -2.5% at 24,509.76
items.summary: Monday's closes, against Friday 13 November: S&P 500 7,416.59 (Friday 7,561.67, -1.9%); Nasdaq Composite 24,509.76 (Friday 25,136.27, -2.5%). The fall built on the weak open reported in last night's update, when chip stocks led the market down.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^GSPC, ^IXIC daily close), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield 5.12%
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.121% on Monday, slightly below Friday's 5.154%. The October FOMC minutes are due on Wednesday.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX daily close), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: JSE All Share closed 0.8% lower at 111,526; Top 40 at 103,629
items.summary: The All Share closed at 111,525.58 on Monday (Friday 112,387.90) and the Top 40 at 103,628.96 (Friday 104,486.60). Given the weaker US close, the JSE may open under pressure today.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^J203.JO, ^J200.JO daily close), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: CPI on Wednesday, SARB on Thursday
items.summary: October CPI is due on Wednesday 18 November (September: 4.5%) and the SARB announces its decision on Thursday 19 November with the repo rate at 7.25%. A Reuters poll quoted on Monday expected October CPI at 5.1%.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT; LRC Market Dashboard, 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Rand at R16.96/$, weaker than Friday
items.summary: USD/ZAR was at 16.9607 early on Tuesday, against 16.7584 at Friday's close (rand about 1.2% weaker). EUR/ZAR was at 18.67 and GBP/ZAR at 22.38.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ZAR=X, EURZAR=X, GBPZAR=X), 17 Nov 2026

items.title: Brent -4.3% to $91.71; gold $3,878.60, platinum $1,474.20, copper lower
items.summary: Monday's closes against Friday: Brent $91.71 (from $95.84); gold futures $3,878.60 (from $3,886.30); platinum $1,474.20 (from $1,488.50); copper about $13,222/t (from about $13,403/t). Lower oil helps the fuel-price outlook for South Africa; softer platinum and copper are a drag on JSE miners.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance BZ=F, GC=F, PL=F, HG=F daily close), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia reports today under interim CEO Colette Kress
items.summary: Nvidia reports quarterly results on Tuesday 17 November, its first since Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO last week. Analysts expect revenue up 91% to $108.93bn (TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026). The shares were at $158.70 in early trade on Monday, below our $262.56 fair value. Our BUY rating is unchanged; the results, not the leadership news, are the real test of it.
items.source: City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT; TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026

items.title: AMD fell with the chip group on Monday
items.summary: AMD was down 5.1% at Monday's open after an 8.8% fall on Friday. Our SELL rating is unchanged.
